paper.title: Deterministic Root-Finding over Finite Fields with Elliptic Curves

main_assessment: The most relevant ECDLP inspiration is implicit set arithmetic and trace power projection, not the determinization of univariate root extraction.
direct_transfer_obstructions: A homomorphism from a prime-order target subgroup to auxiliary smooth groups is trivial if that prime does not divide their orders.
An F_p-isogeny preserves rational point count, so an isogenous curve does not remove the target large prime factor.
The root-finding bound charges polynomial degree and excludes constructing/verifying the elliptic preprocessing datum.
The paper supplies no cheap multivariate selector or compact representation of all pair sums.

trace_reconstruction.status: Implemented blocked trace power projection and native quadratic recurrence in fast_trace/kernel.py; independently audited in trace_audit/. Suggested optimal fast cost remains a research target, not this implementation bound.
trace_reconstruction.assumptions: p>3, split squarefree input u, phi image multiplicities at most two; elliptic-translation domain exceptions handled separately.
trace_reconstruction.formula: q(T)=prod_distinct_images(T-t); a_k=Tr(phi^k); b_k=Tr(g phi^k). N_a=polynomial_part(q(T)*sum a_k T^(-k-1)); multiplicity=N_a/qprime mod q. N_b similarly; N_b/qprime interpolates g on singleton images.
trace_reconstruction.suggested_fast_cost: Otilde(C(d)+d log^2(p)) for a translation component, using standard fast power projection and recurrence algorithms; integration and independent proof review remain necessary.

recommended_primary_kernel.description: Implicit first-relation incidence between three disjoint random labelled point pools; compute an incidence GCD or one witness without expanding every pair sum.
recommended_primary_kernel.identity: N(Z)=Res_X(F1(X), Res_Y(F2(Y), S3(X,Y,Z))); gcd(F3(Z),N(Z)) identifies candidate third coordinates for signed triples.
recommended_primary_kernel.degree_warning: The expanded norm can have degree 2 B^2. Keeping an expression implicit alone does not prove cheaper arithmetic.
recommended_primary_kernel.three_pool_target: B=Theta(r^(1/3)); complete setup+search+recovery O(B^(3/2-epsilon) polylog(r)) for fixed epsilon>0 would beat rho.
recommended_primary_kernel.four_pool_target: B=Theta(r^(1/4)); complete setup+search+recovery O(B^(2-epsilon) polylog(r)) would beat rho.
recommended_primary_kernel.subexponential_boundary: Either fixed-arity target gives a sub-rho exponent, not automatically a subexponential algorithm in log(r).
recommended_primary_kernel.known_label_warning: Geometry-only random labelled pools are valid APS inputs. An arbitrary structured PKM factor base does not come with known mixed labels for free.

conventional_four_summand_cost_bridge.assumptions: Random-sum sparse regime; one relation per successful attempt; solver C(B)=B^gamma; sparse final solve Otilde(B^2); setup charged separately.
conventional_four_summand_cost_bridge.strict_rho_gate: gamma<1; at gamma=1 the density-boundary exponent is 1/2.

arms: Proposed implicit norm with witness extraction
first_experiment.inputs: Identical prime-order curves and public point pools at growing actual B; keep unstructured labelled pools separate from structured PKM bases.
controls: Exceptional denominators and repeated coordinate images
Small p with deg(u)>=p where admissible
metrics: Cold total work including setup and failed attempts
Field operations and complete CPU time
stop_rules: No exponent claim from bounded toy fits.
Do not advance a method merely because its eliminant has few roots.
If it materializes B^2 pair data or a B^2-dimensional algebra, record that cost before claiming a three-pool sub-B^(3/2) algorithm.

conclusion: Measured faster divisor translation than the paper-style dense matrix control. Implicit incidence variants lose to native batched pair enumeration. No new faster complete prime-field ECDLP algorithm established.
